name: Hollow Cherub
why: cracked porcelain: one blow shatters it
look: a cracked porcelain cherub statue come to life, chubby baby angel with empty black eye sockets, chipped stubby moth-like wings, hairline cracks leaking faint light

name: Censer Monk
why: slow and robed: an easy shot
look: a hunched hooded monk in a heavy grey-brown robe, face hidden in shadow, swinging a smoking brass censer on a long chain, incense smoke curling

name: Weeping Saint
why: old stone: big hits crack it
look: a weathered stone statue of a veiled saint with hands clasped, black ichor tears running down its blank face, cracked and mossy marble, floating slightly above a broken plinth

name: Halo Moth
why: papery wings: an arrow tears them
look: a large pale ghostly moth with dusty white wings marked with staring eye patterns, a thin glowing golden ring halo floating above its furry head

name: Penitent
why: faith of iron, mind of glass
look: a gaunt barefoot flagellant in torn sackcloth, a spiked iron cage locked over his head, carrying a heavy chain flail, scarred bony body

name: Seraph Husk
why: huge tattered wings: a target from afar
look: an emaciated fallen angel with six tattered wings of bone and grey feathers, eyes opening all over the wings, holding a broken golden spear, dim cracked halo

name: Bell Wraith
why: strike the bell and it rings itself apart
look: a floating cracked bronze church bell with a pale screaming ghost face inside it, a tattered grey shroud trailing beneath, rusted chain dangling from the top

name: Grave Crawler
why: low to the ground, but holy light burns
look: a legless rotting zombie dragging itself along the ground with long bony arms and clawed fingers, torn grave clothes, spine showing, grey-green skin

name: Ribcage Spider
why: arrows pass through the ribs; a club snaps them
look: a spider built from an old human ribcage, eight long legs of finger bones and joints, a cracked human skull as its head with glowing green eye sockets

name: Lantern Ghoul
why: a scrawny thing once you reach it
look: a hunched grey ghoul with a long lolling tongue and sharp teeth, holding up an iron lantern with a trapped glowing blue soul inside, a satchel of bone shards to throw

name: Coffin Mimic
why: rotten wood shrugs off blows but burns
look: an upright rotting wooden coffin come alive, its lid split into a jagged mouth of teeth and a long tongue, grasping pale arms reaching out of its sides, iron nails and chains

name: Drowned Bride
why: a ghost you can still grab
look: a waterlogged ghost bride in a torn grey wedding dress and long veil, seaweed in her black hair, dripping water, hollow eyes, pale blue-green skin, floating

name: Gravewarden
why: plate and stone, but nothing inside to protect
look: a huge armoured corpse knight in rusted plate armour, holding a cracked tombstone as a shield and a heavy rusted sword, glowing eyes in a dark helm, tattered cape

name: Marrow Leech
why: soft and slow: pinned by a shot
look: a fat pale segmented leech rearing up, its round mouth a ring of tiny human teeth around a skull-like opening, glistening grey skin with dark veins

name: Carrion Stork
why: a tall bird: shot down
look: a gaunt featherless stork with patchy black feathers, ribs showing through grey skin, a long blood-stained beak, thin stilt legs, hunched vulture posture

name: Gutsnout
why: thick hide, dull mind
look: a hairless wrinkled boar-like creature with a mole's snout, far too many crooked teeth, pustules and sores on its pink-grey skin, tiny eyes, stubby clawed legs

name: Gulper
why: all jaw, no mind
look: a blind pale cave fish walking on four fleshy fin-legs, an enormous unhinged jaw full of needle teeth, translucent skin showing bones, no eyes

name: Skinwing
why: thin wings: an arrow brings it down
look: a naked hairless bat with translucent veiny skin wings, huge ragged ears, a wrinkled face with needle teeth, mouth open shrieking

name: Mantis Widow
why: thin limbs: shot from range
look: a gaunt pale praying mantis with a human-like skull face, long scythe forelimbs raised, bone-white chitin with dark veins, thin wings folded

name: Tick Hulk
why: bloated: one arrow pops it
look: a giant engorged tick, swollen dark purple blood-filled body with stretched shiny skin, a small armoured head with barbed mouthparts, eight short hairy legs

name: Rat King
why: a knot of minds, easily confused
look: a knot of many diseased rats fused together, their tails tangled into one writhing mass, multiple snarling heads, a crude crown of bones on the largest rat, green sores

name: Goblin Slinger
why: scrawny up close
look: a scrawny grey cave goblin with big ears and yellow eyes, wearing brass goggles and a ragged loincloth, whirling a leather sling, pouch of stones on his belt

name: Mole Hag
why: frail and blind
look: a blind wrinkled mole-woman crone hunched over, pink star-shaped nose, big digging claws, a dripping candle stuck on her head, leaning on a crooked root staff, ragged shawl

name: Grub Keeper
why: fat and slow
look: a fat pale bald goblin with a big belly, carrying a sack of squirming white grubs over his shoulder and a knotted club, grubs crawling on him, wicked grin

name: Deep Gnawer
why: armoured but simple
look: a blind armoured tunnel rodent with overlapping bony plates on its back, a shovel-shaped bony snout, huge yellow gnawing incisors, big digging claws

name: Lamplurker
why: spindly limbs snap
look: a tall spindly grey cave creature with a long thin neck and huge white pupil-less eyes, holding up a glowing blue mushroom like a lantern, long fingers

name: Troglodyte Brute
why: strong body, dull mind
look: a hulking eyeless grey troglodyte with stone growths on his shoulders, wielding a huge stalactite as a club, hunched with long arms, tattered hide loincloth

name: Gloom Gnome
why: tiny: a swat flattens it
look: a tiny wrinkled old gnome with a long grey beard, wearing a drooping dark mushroom cap as a hat, holding a staff topped with glowing fungus, sly sunken eyes

name: Cinder Husk
why: charred bones crumble
look: a charred black skeleton with molten orange cracks glowing through its bones, smoking ember eyes, wisps of smoke rising, hunched posture

name: Slag Crab
why: rock shell, nothing against a spell
look: a crab whose shell is cooled black lava rock with glowing orange seams, one oversized jagged rock claw, smoke venting from its back

name: Obsidian Stalker
why: glass: a heavy blow shatters it
look: a lean four-legged predator made of jagged black volcanic glass shards, sharp angular body, glowing red crack for a mouth, hunting crouch

name: Rust Revenant
why: empty armour held together by a spell
look: a corroded suit of armour with nothing inside but swirling iron filings and a sickly green glow, flaking orange rust, holding a pitted rusted axe

name: Ash Crone
why: flaking ash: an arrow scatters it
look: a hunched old crone made of flaking grey ash, embers glowing in her eye sockets, holding a smouldering ember lantern, ash drifting off her ragged edges

name: Magma Slug
why: a crusted hide, nothing against a spell
look: a big slug with a cracked dark rock crust on its back and a glowing molten underside, eye stalks, dripping lava from its mouth

name: Basalt Sentinel
why: a big hit cracks the column
look: a tall hexagonal basalt column with a carved stern face, two stone arms of stacked hexagonal rocks, glowing blue runes carved down its body

name: Plague Doctor
why: a doctor, not a fighter
look: a tall plague doctor in a black leather beaked mask with round glass eyes, wide brimmed hat, long waxed coat, holding a glass vial of green liquid ready to throw

name: Grave Robber
why: no protection against curses
look: a hunched cloaked grave robber with a dirty shovel and a lumpy sack over his shoulder, a hooded face with a scarf, small lantern on his belt

name: Butcher
why: a big slow target
look: a huge hooded executioner butcher with a black leather hood, bloodstained apron over a bare belly, holding a massive meat cleaver, hooks and chains on his belt

name: Hexed Puppet
why: wood and string: easily broken
look: a cracked wooden marionette with a porcelain doll face and a painted grin, strings rising up into darkness, jointed limbs dangling, tattered jester clothes

name: Ratcatcher
why: keeps his distance for a reason
look: a gaunt ratcatcher in a long patched coat and floppy hat, rats perched on his shoulders, a small hand crossbow, a cage of rats at his belt

name: Flesh Tailor
why: stitched flesh unravels under spells
look: a tall stitched-together figure of mismatched grey skin, huge scissors for one hand and long needles for fingers on the other, thread hanging from its seams, sewn-shut mouth

name: Goat Cultist
why: a robe, not armour
look: a robed cultist in a dark red hooded robe wearing a goat skull mask with curled horns, holding an open tome with a lit black candle on it, ritual daggers on belt

name: Bile Sack
why: pop it from afar
look: a floating bloated yellow-green bladder creature with tiny veiny wings, dangling fleshy tubes dripping bile, a small puckered mouth and beady eyes

name: Fungal Thrall
why: fungus burns
look: a shambling corpse taken over by mushrooms, brown and red fungus caps sprouting from its back, head and shoulders, spores drifting, glowing fungal eyes, tattered clothes

name: Gas Bloom
why: a stem snaps
look: a carnivorous bulb plant with a swollen purple pod head split open showing fangs, venting green poison spores, thick thorny roots like legs, sickly leaves

name: Pus Maggot
why: soft body: pinned by a shot
look: a fat pale yellowish maggot rearing up, an unsettling human-like mouth with teeth at its front, glistening segmented body oozing pus

name: Miasma Wraith
why: a gas: blades pass through, spells disperse it
look: a ghost formed of swirling green poison gas, a cracked gas-mask skull for a face with glowing lenses, long wispy clawed arms, trailing toxic smoke

name: Leech Matron
why: swollen: a shot bursts her
look: a huge swollen leech queen rearing up, smaller leeches hanging off her glistening dark body, a gaping lamprey mouth ring of teeth, bloated with blood

name: Blister Beetle
why: a stomp cracks it
look: a dark iridescent beetle with glowing green pustule sacks swelling on its back ready to burst, dripping acid, long antennae

name: Rot Crow
why: a bird: shot down
look: a mangy diseased crow with patchy black feathers, exposed sores, a cracked dripping beak, one milky blind eye, hunched on bony feet
